item.title: Voyager 2 Gets 2026 ‘Big Bang’ Update, Extending Life
item.description: NASA’s latest software patch, dubbed ‘Big Bang’, turns off high‑power systems on Voyager 2, swapping them for low‑power alternatives to keep the probe alive for another year.

item.title: Perseverance Rover Sets New Mars Distance Record
item.description: Perseverance rover will break Opportunity’s 45‑km Mars travel record next week, marking a new milestone for robotic exploration for humanity.
